section: Opening answer
claim_or_recommendation: Another competent contractor may assess an existing gate; acceptance depends on the actual installation and support.
qualification: Editorial inference from Maintaining for safety and competence guidance, which contemplates maintenance by people other than original designers. No universal right to repair, brand support or business acceptance promise.

section: Agree what the first inspection will cover
claim_or_recommendation: Powered-gate safety depends on the complete system and the installation circumstances.
qualification: Risk assessment, competence and training; does not assert that replacing one component certifies the whole gate.

section: Check support for the equipment you already have
claim_or_recommendation: Component compatibility must be assessed; visual similarity is not evidence of compatibility.
qualification: System compatibility guidance. Article asks contractor to verify compatibility; names no interchangeable products.

section: Missing paperwork needs a clear plan
claim_or_recommendation: User instructions and a Declaration of Conformity are documents supplied when a completed powered gate first enters service.
qualification: The law section. Does not say a later repair or house sale automatically requires a new declaration, or that a component manual replaces whole-system documentation.

section: Agree the condition in which the engineer will leave the gate
claim_or_recommendation: Those working on gates must consider safe completion and appropriate user information.
qualification: Installers and those undertaking maintenance. Instructions remain specific to the installed equipment; no generic manual-release procedure.

section: Explain why you are changing gate companies
claim_or_recommendation: Example description of a fault and previous controller replacement.
qualification: Illustrative wording for an enquiry, introduced as a description that might be given. Not a real customer project, diagnosis or testimonial.

section: Information, support, quotations, warranty and handover sections
claim_or_recommendation: Collect records, agree inspection scope, check support, obtain written prices and warranty terms, and request a handover record.
qualification: Original purchasing recommendations. No assertion of a standard fee, warranty period, repair time, universal parts availability or legal effect on existing warranties.

section: Opening answer; safety-input section
claim_or_recommendation: On some systems, photocell inputs can prevent closing or cause reversal; a sustained opening command can hold the gate open.
qualification: Nice A6/A6F/A700F manual, English sections 4 and 5. Model-specific illustration from a legacy manual, not a cross-brand fault diagnosis or current recommended programming. No switch positions, terminal instructions or numerical specifications reproduced.

section: The gate may be waiting for a different command
claim_or_recommendation: Nice A5 offers automatic closure and a setting which waits for another command.
qualification: English Standard operation and Programmable functions. Legacy controller example only; reader directed to own instructions, not to copy settings.

section: Stopping or reversing needs a wider assessment
claim_or_recommendation: Gate assessment considers mountings, movement, environment and protective response.
qualification: Delivering safety and site-specific assessment sections; observation does not diagnose a failed hinge, roller or motor.

section: Report rain, electrical trips and recent damage
claim_or_recommendation: Water ingress and damaged electrical connections can create powered-gate hazards.
qualification: Risks from powered gates. Rain preceding a fault does not prove water ingress or identify a failed component.

section: Opening and access arrangements
claim_or_recommendation: Keep clear of faulty machinery and leave hazardous testing, enclosure access and intervention to competent contractors.
qualification: Safety recommendation based on unexpected movement, entrapment, electrical and work-on-gate hazards. No live electrical, release, force-adjustment or bypass procedure.

section: Fault records, inspection and repair comparison
claim_or_recommendation: Give an observation-based fault history and ask the engineer to connect proposed work to a diagnosis.
qualification: Original editorial recommendations. No statistical ranking of common causes, promise of a particular fix or guaranteed inspection outcome.

section: Ask for a condition assessment
claim_or_recommendation: The complete gate and retained parts need assessment; a new motor alone does not settle system safety.
qualification: Whole-system principle. No age-based replacement rule or assertion that all existing components can be reused.

section: Consider replacing the automation
claim_or_recommendation: Significant modifications can require new conformity assessment.
qualification: Installers section. Conditional language retained; not all component repairs are treated as new machinery.

section: Ask what support follows the work
claim_or_recommendation: Powered gates need regular checks and maintenance.
qualification: The basics for safety. No universal service frequency, warranty maintenance condition or fixed test interval.

section: History, repair, replacement, quotation and handover sections
claim_or_recommendation: Compare a diagnosed repair, automation replacement and complete replacement by written scope and retained equipment.
qualification: Original decision framework. No lifecycle forecast, monetary threshold, precise lifespan, repair percentage or guarantee of lower cost.

section: Give complete replacement a defined scope
claim_or_recommendation: Ask who will check property constraints if the design or boundary changes.
qualification: Purchasing question only, not a planning-law statement or assurance that any work is permitted.

section: End CTA
claim_or_recommendation: Get a Free Quote; tell us about the gate and the work being considered.
qualification: CTA supplied by user in the brief; live route verified. No free repair inspection, response-time, universal acceptance or warranty promise added.
